ns2:course.label: Seminar for Advanced Students
ns2:course.description: Seminar in the education of individuals with disabilities; open only to persons who have been admitted for graduate study. 0 to 8 graduate hours. No professional credit. Approved for Letter and S/U grading. May be repeated in separate terms to a maximum of 8 hours.
